idea-plugin.name: LLMs.txt & Agents.md Support
idea-plugin.description:
Make your site visible to AI shopping agents — without leaving your IDE.

First-class editor support for llms.txt and agents.md, the emerging AI-agent content standards adopted natively by Shopify and read by ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini crawlers. Built by the team behind the free AgentReady AI-visibility scanner.

  • Syntax highlighting for llms.txt, llms-full.txt and agents.md: title, summary blockquote, section headers and link bullets each get their own color.
  • Code completion for canonical llms.txt sections (## Docs, ## Products, ## Policies, ## Optional…) and common agents.md sections (## Setup commands, ## Code style, ## PR instructions…).
  • Live spec validation with quick-fixes: missing H1 title, missing summary blockquote, malformed link bullets, relative (non-absolute) URLs, and empty sections.
  • Generators: scaffold a best-practice llms.txt or agents.md from Tools → LLMs.txt & Agents.md, or from the New file menu.
  • AgentReady audit tool window: scan any site's agentic-commerce readiness (robots.txt AI-crawler policy, llms.txt, agents.md, JSON-LD Product/Offer schema, sitemap, meta basics) and get a 0–100 score with a prioritized fix list.

Keywords: llms.txt, llms-full.txt, agents.md, AGENTS.md, AI SEO, GEO, generative engine optimization, AI visibility, agentic commerce, ACP, MCP, ChatGPT Shopping, AI crawlers, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, structured data, JSON-LD.

Includes a 30-day free trial — licensing is handled by JetBrains Marketplace.
